lines.t: The air is still, the dawn is near
The veil of night begins to clear
From ashes rise, the hearts once torn
Awaken now, the bride is reborn
Hear the sound of holy rain
Falling softly, calling her name
The lamps are lit, the hearts are pure
The cry goes out, he stands at the door
Spirit whispers, lift your eyes
The heaven's open light fills the skies
The bride adorned in robes of white
Steps forth to meet the King of light
Yahushua, the Spirit of the Bride
Your glory rises like the sun
The wedding feast of heaven begun
Every tear you wipe away
Every night fades to day
Holy fire, pure and true
The bride belongs to you
Voices echo across the sea
The sound of love and victory
The trumpet calls the heavens sing
The bride awaits her coming king
Holy, holy, faithful, true
Yahushua, all for you
The gates of pearl, the streets of gold
The stories of the prophets told
The Lamb has conquered death undone
The glory of heaven, the glorious one
Her soul remembers every word
The still small voice she once had heard
Now face to face she sees the King
And every breath of life shall sing
Yahushua, the Spirit and the bride say come
Your glory rises like the sun
The wedding feast of heaven begun
Every tear you wipe away
Every night fades to day
Holy fire, pure and true
The bride belongs to you
Heaven opens, earth stands still
Love eternal, perfect will
Trumpets calling, angels sing
Behold, the bride awakes for the King
Holy, holy, forever free
Yahushua, come for your bride
Light like rivers through the sky
The song of love will never die
Eternal one, always near
The bride awakes, the king is here
Yahushua
Yahushua
The Spirit and the Bride say come
Your glory rises like the sun
The wedding feast of heaven begun
Every tear you wipe away
Every night fades to day
Holy fire, pure and true
The bride belongs to you
